candidates.source_title: The Beautiful Green Color That Was Secretly Toxic #history
candidates.source_description:
In the 1800s, bright green became one of the most fashionable colors.

But some of those vivid greens were made with arsenic-based pigments. They appeared in dresses, wallpaper, toys, and other everyday products before people fully understood how dangerous the exposure could be.

What looked luxurious could come with a hidden cost.

History, victorian era
